plugin.title: User Account
plugin.description: User registration, authentication, credential management, and account-related actions.

sso_authentication.title: SSO authentication
sso_authentication.description: Allows users to authenticate through the main domain using single sign-on.

registration_enabled.title: Registration enabled
registration_enabled.description: Allows new users to register on this domain.

two_factor_auth.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor_auth.description: Enables two-factor authentication for supported sign-in flows.

login_action.title: Action after sign-in
login_action.description: Defines what happens after a successful sign-in.

email_activation.title: Email activation required
email_activation.description: Requires email verification for users who register with email and password.

admin_activation_required.title: Administrator activation required
admin_activation_required.description: Keeps newly registered accounts inactive until an administrator activates them.

redirect_page.title: Redirect page URL
redirect_page.description: URL used after sign-in when the redirect action is selected.
